comments.t: The ingredient Prostaglandin analog etc in these serums are known to change the color of your eyes. In addition, they have been found to AGE the eyes and the skin around them. One of the reasons I stopped using Latisse years ago!
Saw your earlier video about revitalash. Been using it for about 9 months. My lashes are longer and thicker than ever in my life.  I’m 71!!

I bought Revitalash a few years ago and it definitely lengthened my lashes, but it also caused horrendous dry eyes - I researched this and found that this can be a side effect.  Unfortunately I had to throw it away (and it’s not cheap 😭) and I still, to a lesser degree thankfully, have dry eyes to this day.  I know it’s great for many people, but it’s just something to be aware of!  I’m still on the hunt for an alternative but as I don’t know what ingredient caused the dry eyes I’d be very wary of trying another 😟

I’ve been using Babe Lash on my eyelashes and brows and OMG! I look like I have eye lash extensions, seriously I can’t live without it now. I’m on my 3rd tube. I’ve tried Grande and Lash MD and nada! So, like you said, try them out and find what works for you. I’ve recommended Babe Lash to several people. My lashes were so puny and now, they are so thick, full and longer and I don’t even need to curl them and one coat of mascara, wow!! You are gorgeous and you really are aging in reverse. I feel that way sometimes, I’m 48 and people think I’m 35, so that always feels great!!! Happy Hump day!
Omg, this is the exact same mix I use! Revitalash on my eyes and Babe lash on my brows. It really works! 👌🏽
Thank God.  Very timely since I've noticed my lashes are thinning.  Thanks, Angie!
Just ordered the Revitalash! Yassss! I was using Grande lash md. It just stopped working. Excited to see how this works. Thank you beautiful Angie! 😍❤️
I agree the Revitalash is my HG for lashes.

Read the description. “Some of the links above are affiliate links which means I make a small commission when you purchase a product through that link.” She linked 2 of the lash serums she mentioned, including Babe Lash. For everyone wondering why she contradicted her medical advice (although the description denies this is medical advice for legal reasons) regarding prostaglandins, it’s because she’s profiting from it. If an influencer mentions a product by name, especially a supposed medical professional, run to the caption or description for evidence of sponsorship. So no, Babe Lash is not an exception, she just gets paid every time she convinces someone it is.
The alarming amount of ppl who use all these lash serums but have no idea on the side affects  ty for informing us on better alternatives.
Good to know. I got a free sample of GrandLasheMD serum from Ulta. I don't really need it as my glaucoma drops makes my lashes grow longer anyway.
